summary: The bill amends the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act to exclude from the definition of tobacco product any premium cigar that is wrapped in whole tobacco leaf, uses a 100% leaf binder and at least 50% long-filler tobacco, is handmade without machinery, has no filter or non-tobacco tip, contains only tobacco/water/vegetable gum with no additives or characterizing flavors, and weighs more than six pounds per thousand units.

scores.thoughts: The bill makes no reference to federal appropriations, budgets, or expenditures. It is solely a regulatory exemption under the FD&C Act.
No provisions alter tax rates, credits, deductions, or revenue collection mechanisms.

While the bill removes certain FDA oversight of a tobacco product, the healthcare topic is defined around coverage models (public vs. market-based insurance and delivery). The legislation does not address insurance, Medicare, Medicaid, or healthcare access structures.
No connection to firearms, Second Amendment issues, or related regulations.
The bill contains no immigration, border, or visa provisions.
No provisions relate to reproductive health services or abortion access.
No military, defense, or national security spending or policy changes.
No environmental, emissions, or regulatory provisions affecting climate policy.
No changes to welfare programs, SNAP, housing assistance, or similar entitlements.
No education funding, school choice, or federal education policy provisions.

Although tobacco is a regulated substance, the topic definition centers on illicit drugs, decriminalization, and enforcement. The bill addresses a narrow FDA exemption for premium cigars and does not engage drug-policy frameworks.
No sentencing, policing, or criminal justice reform measures.
No tariffs, trade agreements, or import/export policy changes.
No fiscal policy, deficit, or debt-reduction provisions.
No provisions addressing LGBTQ legal protections or related civil rights.
No foreign assistance or international aid provisions.
No election administration, voting access, or campaign finance measures.
No technology, data privacy, or platform regulation content.
No labor, union, or workplace rights provisions.
No religious exemptions, anti-discrimination rules, or conscience protections addressed.
